blocks.text: Homegrown music took center stage at SM City Bicutan as local bands brought their own sounds and stage presence to the mall’s Battle of the Bands on Sept. 26. Held at the mall’s Events Center, the competition featured Filipino bands performing live for mallgoers, with each group showcasing its own musical style and performance. The event also gave emerging musicians a chance to perform in front of a live audience and connect with listeners beyond the competition. More than just the performances, the Battle of the Bands also came with prizes for the winning groups. The champion received P20,000 worth of […]...
